verdict.rationale: Runloop documents suspending a devbox to preserve its state and resuming it later "exactly where you left off", including a dedicated suspend/resume workflow tutorial and idle/shutdown controls. Snapshots separately save disk state. That covers the core pause-and-resume story with filesystem persistence. Memory preservation is only implied by the "exactly where you left off" wording and is never stated explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that in-memory/process state survives suspend, in-depth API reference for suspend/resume semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
